{{ao.missing_point}}per_ao[].missing_points[]One line each, max three (05-MARK-004).
{{glyph}}, {{point.marking_point_id}}, {{point.line}}per_point[].glyph, .marking_point_id; line text = .reason, else for an unmet conjunctive point the failed atom's own wording from the scheme (05-WRKD-003)Points Marks only.
{{advice.primary_action.text}}, .expected_gainnext_mark_advice.primary_action.text, .expected_gainExactly one primary action, always last.
{{advice.secondary[].label}}next_mark_advice.secondary[].kind (+ .target_ao) through the microcopy catalogue (§15.E)Max two buttons.

Fixed lexicon for a span line when span.reason is absent. A lookup table, not generated prose: causal_chain + links_counted ≥ 2 → "a {{links_counted}}-link chain — that is developed analysis"; causal_chain + links_counted == 1 → "stops after one link"; application → "a fact true only of this business"; judgement → "a judgement, committed"; knowledge → "accurate and relevant"; working → "method shown"; diagram → "the arrow and its source both present". Reason codes map the same way (SINGLE_LINK → "one link only"; ASSERTION_NO_LINK → "an assertion with nothing following"; GENERIC_NOT_CONTEXT → "true of any business"; EVAL_IN_ANALYSE, NO_WORKING, UNITS_MISSING → the fixed lines already owned by 05-PROC-004, 05-PROC-011 and 05-PROC-009).

Omission rules — what disappears when a field is absent. Never render an empty heading, a dangling colon or a placeholder.

ConditionRendered result
total_band == null (below gate, 05-GATE-004)The whole band strip is replaced by "Feedback only — this paper is not yet calibrated"; the tolerance sentence is dropped; everything else is unchanged (05-WRKD-004).
calibration_status.state == "provisional"badge_text line reads "Practice estimate — not yet calibrated" (05-MARK-010).
visibility.show_number == falseNo number appears in the strip or in any {{ao.marks}} of {{ao.max}} line; the level and the AO name stay.
header.level_procedure == "points"Render per_point[] blocks; omit every per_ao block, and vice versa.
credited_spans / partial_spans / uncredited_attempts emptyThat prefix line is omitted; an AO with all three empty renders its heading line only.
missing_points emptyOmitted.
examiner_warnings empty, or none matches this AOOmitted; never render "no warnings".
application_check == nullThe cover-the-name line is omitted (non-case items).
A span whose offsets no longer resolve in the transcriptDropped from the rationale and the answer pane, and logged (05-WRKD-002).
visibility.show_teacher_flag == trueOne extra line after the affected AO: "An examiner is checking {{ao.name}}." (05-PIPE-008).
challenge_state != "none"One status line under the strip from the §15.E catalogue; no other slot changes.
IDRequirementAcceptance
15-RUBR-005Each template carries template_id and template_version; the compiler strips the three header keys, validates the remainder against MarkScheme@3, and stamps template_id@version on the emitted record for provenance.A record whose template_id is unknown, or whose header keys survive into the Pack, fails the compile.
15-RUBR-006The rationale renderer generates no text at render time. Every rendered sentence traces to a Mark field, the fixed lexicon in this subsection, the §15.E catalogue, or the Pack.Static check over the renderer bundle: no string concatenation into a rationale slot outside the lexicon module; the 05.12 fixtures render byte-identically (15-RUBR-003).
15-RUBR-007Pack.syllabus.assessment_objectives[] carries short_name (extends §06.3); the renderer reads it and never abbreviates an AO name in code.A Pack with a null short_name fails mapped; renderer test asserts "AO3 Analysis" comes from the Pack.
15-RUBR-008In a points template, the sum of blocks[].max equals marks_total, and every marking_points[].id appears in at most one block; points outside every block are awardable without a cap.Compiler validation error naming the block and the offending sum (15-RUBR-004).
15-RUBR-009A template whose family sets diagram_required: true must also set vision_status, and the Mark it produces renders with visibility.show_number = false until that diagram family's gold set passes 05-GATE-002.Fixture: a mechanism Mark before the gate shows the band and the provisional banner, no number (06-TEN-003, 15-TAG-007).

15.CJSON schemas

Nine schemas, JSON Schema draft 2020-12, one $id each: common@1, MarkScheme@3, Item@2, Attempt@2, Mark@3, LearnerState@2, Pack@2 (15.C.1–15.C.7) and ItemTags@1, CommandWord@1 (15.D). Field names are those already used in 05.2 (Mark), 05.3 (MarkScheme), 07.1 (LearnerState), SYNTHESIS §3.1 (Attempt, Item) and F§7.1 / 06.3 (Pack). Where the worked example in 05.2 or 05.3 is more detailed than the schema, the example is normative for values and this schema is normative for types and required fields. Common definitions ($defs) are shared through common@1.

15.C is the single normative type source. One spelling of a schema name exists — Name@n, matching scheme_id@n and pack_version — and it is the only legal schema_id in config, prompts, telemetry and persisted objects; mark.v1, item.v2, card.v1 and plan.v1 are not aliases, they are defects. Enum literals in §11's DDL and in the §08 log tables reference these $defs rather than restating them: a ∈ {…} list elsewhere in the document that does not resolve to a $defs name fails the docs lint.

IDRequirementAcceptance
15-SCHM-001All nine schemas live in schemas/ with schema_version bumped on any change; producers validate before persist and consumers validate on read; validation failure is an error, never a coercion (00-APP-003).CI validates every fixture in evals/gold/** and every golden conversation artefact against the current version.
15-SCHM-002additionalProperties: false on every object except Pack.extensions and Item.generator; field additions are a new schema_version; removals and renames are forbidden for Mark (05.2) and Attempt.Schema diff job blocks a PR that removes a required key.
15-SCHM-003The provider structured-output grammar for Mark@3 is generated from these files, never hand-written (08-CACH-009). The Learn route emits prose plus a small metadata part and has no schema of its own (08-SCH-006); nothing may cite a learn_turn@n.Grammar hash equals the build output; a reference to an undefined schema name fails the docs lint.
15-SCHM-004Every JSON and YAML block printed anywhere in this document is a fixture in schemas/examples/ and is validated in CI against the $id it claims. An example that fails its schema is a build error, not an illustration.The CI job parses every fenced json/yaml block in the master prompt, resolves its schema, and validates; unresolvable blocks are listed explicitly as prose-only.
15-SCHM-005The $id host is brand-independent: schemas are published at https://schema.{brand_domain}/… with brand_domain resolved from config/brand.yaml at build time, and a Receipt carries issuer_url in its signed payload rather than a baked host in the QR. The literals printed below are the current resolution, not a constant. Why: 01-NAME-001 marks the name PROVISIONAL until M2 clearance, and a $id ends up inside every persisted artefact and every signed Receipt — a rename after launch would otherwise be unbounded.Zero brand-domain literals outside config/brand.yaml, including inside JSON $id values and signed payloads (01-NAME-002).

Identifier and version grammar. Five of these have carried two or more forms across the document; one row each, and every producer validates against it.

IdentifierGrammarExampleNotes
Object ids^[a-z]{3}_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$ (ULID with a three-letter prefix)mrk_01JX8Z…Registered prefixes: mrk_ Mark · att_ Attempt · itm_ Item · rcp_ Receipt · ses_ Session · crd_ Card · pl_ provenance-ledger row. A two-letter prefix (mk_) is invalid.
policy_version^\d{4}\.\d{2}\.\d+(-rc\d+)?$2026.09.2One dated label over the whole manifest of prompts, routes, schemas and Packs (08-EVG-001). Never per paper: per-paper marker identity is header.scheme_id plus provenance.marker_instructions_version.
pack_version^[0-9]{4}:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}@[0-9]{4}\.[0-9]{1,2}\.[0-9]+$9609:2026-2028@2026.11.2The only stored form. pack_version_display ("2026–28 v3") is derived for the UI banner and is never persisted on an Attempt or a Mark.
syllabus_version^[0-9]{4}:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}$9609:2026-2028The pack_version without its build stamp.
scheme_id^ms_[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[0-9]+$ms_9609_41_MJ25_Q1@3The @n is the scheme record's own version, bumped by any edit to the grid.
question_ref (canonical question reference){syllabus}/{component}/{series}/{yy}/Q{n}{part} with series ∈ {F/M, M/J, O/N} and a two-digit year9609/22/M/J/25/Q3bA reference, never a primary key: it identifies a question in board notation and joins to an Item by item_id, which is always a ULID (06-PACK-002). Stored structured on Item@2.question_ref; question_ref.canonical is the derived string and is what the log tables and the §08 telemetry carry.
series^(F/M\|M/J\|O/N)/[0-9]{2}$M/J/25Two-digit year, matching 06-PACK-002's normaliser. The earlier ^[MJON]/[JN]/[0-9]{4}$ form admitted N/J/2025 and J/N/2025, which are not Cambridge series, and used a four-digit year the normaliser never emits. Series and year are one field; never a series: "M/J" + year: 2025 pair.

15.C.1 common@1

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/common@1",
  "$defs": {
    "ulid": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z]{3}_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$" },
    "ts": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
    "ao": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^AO[1-6]$" },
    "provenance": { "enum": ["OWN", "LICENSED", "USER"] },
    "syllabus_point_id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)*$", "examples": ["9609/3.2.1"] },
    "item_type": { "enum": ["numeric", "short_answer", "levels", "mechanism", "practical", "mcq"] },
    "command_word": { "type": "string", "minLength": 3, "maxLength": 20 },
    "mark_glyph": { "enum": ["✓", "×", "Ø", "BOD", "CON", "RE", "GA", "ECF", "NC", "I"] },
    "reason_code": { "enum": ["SINGLE_LINK", "ASSERTION_NO_LINK", "GENERIC_NOT_CONTEXT", "EVAL_IN_ANALYSE", "TERM_REPEATED_IN_DEFINITION", "WRONG_STAKEHOLDER", "NO_WORKING", "UNITS_MISSING", "SIG_FIG", "CONTRADICTION", "ILLEGIBLE", "OUT_OF_SCOPE", "NOT_IN_INDICATIVE_VALID_ALT", "DUPLICATE_POINT"] },
    "span": { "type": "object", "required": ["quote", "char_start", "char_end", "line_ref"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "quote": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 }, "char_start": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "char_end": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }, "line_ref": { "type": "string" },
        "marking_point_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "evidence_kind": { "enum": ["causal_chain", "application", "judgement", "knowledge", "working", "diagram", null] },
        "links_counted": { "type": ["integer", "null"], "minimum": 0 }, "reason_code": { "$ref": "#/$defs/reason_code" }, "reason": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 } } },
    "source_ref": { "type": "object", "required": ["kind", "citation", "trust_rank"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "kind": { "enum": ["syllabus", "textbook", "mark_scheme", "examiner_report", "revision_notes", "user_upload", "threshold_table"] }, "citation": { "type": "string" }, "deep_link": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "uri" }, "extract": { "type": ["string", "null"], "maxLength": 320 }, "trust_rank": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 6 }, "document_id": { "type": "string" }, "page": { "type": ["integer", "null"] } } },
    "confidence3": { "enum": ["sure", "think_so", "guessing"] },
    "mastery_state": { "enum": ["Unseen", "Shaky", "Secure", "Exam-ready"] },
    "version_tag": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}@[0-9]{4}\\.[0-9]{1,2}\\.[0-9]+$", "examples": ["9609:2026-2028@2026.11.2"] },
    "policy_version": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}\\.[0-9]{2}\\.[0-9]+(-rc[0-9]+)?$", "examples": ["2026.09.2"] },
    "series": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^(F/M|M/J|O/N)/[0-9]{2}$", "examples": ["M/J/25"] },
    "readiness": { "enum": ["draft", "ingested", "mapped", "gold_seeded", "gated", "live"] },
    "twin_state": { "enum": ["not_yet_calibrated", "gold_seeded", "provisional", "gated", "live", "paused"] },
    "licence_basis": { "type": "object", "required": ["basis"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "basis": { "enum": ["own", "licensed", "user", "quotation", "public_with_permission"] }, "licence_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
        "quotation": { "type": ["object", "null"], "required": ["exception", "jurisdiction", "reviewed_by", "reviewed_at"], "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": { "exception": { "enum": ["uk_cdpa_s30", "us_fair_use", "eu_art5_quotation", "other"] }, "jurisdiction": { "type": "string" }, "reviewed_by": { "type": "string" }, "reviewed_at": { "type": "string", "format": "date" }, "note": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 } } } },
      "allOf": [ { "if": { "properties": { "basis": { "const": "quotation" } } }, "then": { "required": ["quotation"], "properties": { "quotation": { "type": "object" } } } },
                 { "if": { "properties": { "basis": { "enum": ["licensed", "public_with_permission"] } } }, "then": { "required": ["licence_id"], "properties": { "licence_id": { "type": "string" } } } } ] }
  } }

15.C.2 MarkScheme@3 (one record per question part; 05.3)

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/MarkScheme@3",
  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["id", "question_id", "syllabus_version", "paper", "marks_total", "command_word", "command_word_def_ref", "ao_ceiling", "scheme_type", "generic_principles_ref", "wording_status", "marking_points", "levels", "best_fit", "ecf_policy", "source"],
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^ms_[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[0-9]+$" },
    "question_id": { "type": "string" }, "part": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "syllabus_version": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}$" },
    "paper": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }, "marks_total": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 40 },
    "command_word": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/command_word" }, "command_word_def_ref": { "type": "string" }, "ao_ceiling": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" },
    "scheme_type": { "enum": ["points", "levels", "mixed"] },
    "generic_principles_ref": { "type": "string" }, "wording_status": { "enum": ["own_paraphrase", "licensed_verbatim"] },
    "context": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["case_facts"],
      "properties": { "case_study_id": { "type": "string" }, "business_name": { "type": "string" }, "case_facts": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "minItems": 1 } } },
    "marking_points": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["id", "type", "marks", "credit_text"],
      "properties": { "id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{1,2}$" }, "type": { "enum": ["M", "A", "B", "DM", "DB", "FT"] }, "marks": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }, "ao": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" },
        "credit_text": { "type": "string" }, "conjunctive_conditions": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "default": [] }, "all_required": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
        "depends_on": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "ecf_allowed": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "cao": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "isw": { "type": "boolean", "default": false },
        "accept": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "reject": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "ignore": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
        "alternatives": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "ora": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "notes": { "type": "string" }, "diagram_required": { "type": "boolean" } },
      "if": { "properties": { "type": { "enum": ["A", "DM", "DB"] } } }, "then": { "required": ["depends_on"], "properties": { "depends_on": { "type": "string" } } } } },
    "levels": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["ao", "max", "bands"],
      "properties": { "ao": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" }, "max": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 },
        "bands": { "type": "array", "minItems": 2, "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["level", "range", "descriptor", "evidence_rule"],
          "properties": { "level": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "range": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "minItems": 2, "maxItems": 2 }, "descriptor": { "type": "string" }, "evidence_rule": { "type": "string", "minLength": 8 } } },
          "contains": { "properties": { "level": { "const": 0 } } } } } } },
    "best_fit": { "type": "boolean" },
    "ecf_policy": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["allowed"], "properties": { "allowed": { "type": "boolean" }, "scope": { "enum": ["none", "within-part", "across-parts", "whole-question"] } } },
    "penalties": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": { "sig_fig_once_per_paper": { "type": "boolean" }, "units_missing": { "enum": ["lose_A_mark", "lose_B_mark", "none", null] } } },
    "caps": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["when", "max_total"], "properties": { "when": { "type": "string" }, "max_total": { "type": "integer" } } } },
    "blocks": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["name", "point_ids", "max"], "properties": { "name": { "type": "string" }, "point_ids": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "max": { "type": "integer" } } } },
    "indicative_content": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["id", "text"], "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" }, "text": { "type": "string" }, "ao_hint": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" } } } },
    "diagram_required": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "diagram_checklist": { "type": "object" },
    "vision_status": { "enum": ["not_applicable", "provisional_teacher_confirm", "gated"] },
    "exemplars_ref": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "examiner_insight_refs": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "tolerance": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 3 },
    "source": { "type": "object", "required": ["document_id", "trust_rank", "licence_basis"], "properties": { "document_id": { "type": "string" }, "page": { "type": "integer" }, "trust_rank": { "type": "integer" }, "licence_basis": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/licence_basis" } } }
  },
  "allOf": [
    { "if": { "properties": { "scheme_type": { "const": "levels" } } }, "then": { "properties": { "levels": { "minItems": 1 }, "marking_points": { "maxItems": 0 } } } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "scheme_type": { "const": "points" } } }, "then": { "properties": { "marking_points": { "minItems": 1 }, "levels": { "maxItems": 0 } } } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "diagram_required": { "const": true } } }, "then": { "required": ["vision_status"] } }
  ] }

15.C.3 Item@2 (atomic retrievable or gradable unit; SYNTHESIS §3.1, tagging in 15.D)

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/Item@2",
  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["item_id", "kind", "provenance", "syllabus_code", "syllabus_version", "syllabus_points", "item_type", "text_status", "tags", "presolve", "stats", "created_at"],
  "properties": {
    "item_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ulid" },
    "kind": { "enum": ["definition", "formula", "skill", "evaluation_point", "diagram_rule", "question_part"] },
    "provenance": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/provenance" }, "licence_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "org_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "syllabus_code": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}$" }, "syllabus_version": { "type": "string" },
    "syllabus_points": { "type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/syllabus_point_id" } },
    "item_type": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/item_type" },
    "text_status": { "enum": ["own", "licensed", "ref_only"] },
    "text": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "stimulus": { "type": ["object", "null"], "properties": { "text": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1400 }, "business_name": { "type": "string" }, "currency": { "type": "string" }, "tables": { "type": "array" } } },
    "question_ref": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["paper", "series", "part", "canonical"], "properties": { "paper": { "type": "integer" }, "series": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/series" }, "variant": { "type": ["integer", "null"] }, "part": { "type": "string" }, "canonical": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/(F/M|M/J|O/N)/[0-9]{2}/Q[0-9]+[a-z]*(\\([iv]+\\))?$" } } },
    "tags": { "$ref": "ItemTags@1" },
    "scheme_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "presolve": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["status"], "properties": { "status": { "enum": ["pending", "verified", "disputed", "failed"] }, "key_ref": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "solvers": { "type": "array", "items": { "enum": ["claude-opus-5", "gpt-5.6-sol", "deepseek-v4-pro-anon"] } }, "sympy_ok": { "type": ["boolean", "null"] }, "expected_wrong_values": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["value", "misconception_id"], "properties": { "value": { "type": "string" }, "misconception_id": { "type": "string" } } } } } },
    "misconception_targets": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "distractor_map": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" } },
    "diagram_required": { "type": "boolean", "default": false },
    "stats": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["n", "p_correct", "discrimination", "mean_latency"], "properties": { "n": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "p_correct": { "type": ["number", "null"], "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1 }, "discrimination": { "type": ["number", "null"] }, "mean_latency": { "type": ["number", "null"], "minimum": 0 } } },
    "generator": { "type": ["object", "null"], "properties": { "seed_family": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "checks": { "type": "object" }, "teacher_review": { "enum": ["pending", "accepted", "rejected", null] }, "model": { "type": "string" } } },
    "equivalent_to": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "created_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }, "retired_at": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date-time" }
  },
  "allOf": [
    { "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "question_part" } } }, "then": { "required": ["scheme_id"], "properties": { "scheme_id": { "type": "string" } } } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "text_status": { "const": "ref_only" } } }, "then": { "properties": { "text": { "type": "null" } }, "required": ["question_ref"] } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "provenance": { "const": "USER" } } }, "then": { "required": ["org_id"] } }
  ] }

15.C.4 Attempt@2 (SYNTHESIS §3.1 + 04-GATE-007 + 04-NSTR-003)

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/Attempt@2",
  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["attempt_id", "user_id", "course_id", "session_id", "item_id", "syllabus_points", "response", "gate_state", "entry_rung", "rung_reached", "intent", "seen_solution", "timed", "item_first_seen_at", "policy_version", "pack_version", "slot", "phase", "created_at"],
  "properties": {
    "attempt_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ulid" }, "user_id": { "type": "string" }, "course_id": { "type": "string" }, "session_id": { "type": "string" }, "item_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ulid" },
    "syllabus_points": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/syllabus_point_id" }, "minItems": 1 },
    "response": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["text", "transcript_confirmed"],
      "properties": { "text": { "type": "string" }, "transcript_confirmed": { "type": "boolean" }, "image_ids": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "transcript_edits": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object" } }, "illegible_share": { "type": ["number", "null"] }, "word_count": { "type": "integer" } } },
    "gate_state": { "enum": ["open", "satisfied", "timeboxed", "bypassed_answer"] }, "gate_reason": { "enum": ["attempt", "plan", "dont_know_plus_sentence", "timebox", "ask_no_course", "mark_mode_paste", "worked_example_checkpoint", "check_steps_supplied", null] },
    "gate_latency_ms": { "type": ["integer", "null"], "minimum": 0 }, "gate_path": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "entry_rung": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 5 }, "rung_reached": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 5 }, "rung_relief": { "type": "boolean", "default": false },
    "intent": { "enum": ["teach_me", "check_steps", "just_answer", "none"] },
    "seen_solution": { "type": "boolean" }, "self_explained": { "type": ["boolean", "null"] },
    "confidence": { "anyOf": [{ "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/confidence3" }, { "type": "null" }] },
    "timed": { "type": "boolean" }, "item_first_seen_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" },
    "error_class": { "enum": ["slip", "misconception", "missing_prerequisite", null] }, "misconception_candidate": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "mark_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "mark_per_AO": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 } },
    "marker_gate_status": { "enum": ["gated", "provisional", "uncalibrated", null] },
    "teacher_override": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["teacher_id", "reason_code", "original_total", "new_total", "at"], "properties": { "teacher_id": { "type": "string" }, "reason_code": { "type": "string" }, "original_total": { "type": "integer" }, "new_total": { "type": "integer" }, "confirmed_by": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" } } },
    "affect_tags": { "type": "array", "items": { "enum": ["neutral", "frustrated", "give_up", "off_topic", "distress", "crisis"] } },
    "policy_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/policy_version" }, "pack_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/version_tag" },
    "slot": { "enum": ["due", "interleaved", "new", "timed", "probe", "retest", "mark_paste"] }, "phase": { "enum": ["A", "B", "C", "between_papers"] },
    "latency_to_first_token_ms": { "type": ["integer", "null"] }, "incognito": { "type": "boolean", "default": false },
    "created_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }
  },
  "allOf": [
    { "if": { "properties": { "rung_reached": { "const": 5 } } }, "then": { "properties": { "seen_solution": { "const": true } } } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "intent": { "const": "just_answer" } } }, "then": { "properties": { "seen_solution": { "const": true }, "gate_state": { "enum": ["satisfied", "timeboxed", "bypassed_answer"] } } } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "slot": { "const": "timed" } } }, "then": { "properties": { "timed": { "const": true } }, "required": ["confidence"] } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "incognito": { "const": true } } }, "then": { "properties": { "mark_id": { "type": "null" } } } }
  ] }

15.C.5 Mark@3 (05.2 contract; removals and renames forbidden)

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/Mark@3",
  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["mark_id", "attempt_id", "created_at", "header", "total_band", "command_word_check", "next_mark_advice", "annotations", "calibration_status", "sources", "provenance", "challenge_state", "visibility", "procedure_used"],
  "properties": {
    "mark_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ulid" }, "attempt_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ulid" }, "supersedes": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "created_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" },
    "header": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["question_id", "tariff", "command_word", "ao_split", "scheme_id", "scheme_wording_status", "pack_version", "level_procedure"],
      "properties": { "question_id": { "type": "string" }, "part": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "tariff": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }, "command_word": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/command_word" }, "ao_split": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "type": "integer" } }, "scheme_id": { "type": "string" }, "scheme_wording_status": { "enum": ["own_paraphrase", "licensed_verbatim"] }, "pack_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/version_tag" }, "level_procedure": { "enum": ["best_fit", "ladder_up", "top_down", "bullet_evidence", "points"] }, "business_name": { "type": ["string", "null"] } } },
    "total_band": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["low", "modal", "high", "tolerance"], "properties": { "low": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "modal": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "high": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "tolerance": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 3 } } },
    "per_ao": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["ao", "max", "level", "marks", "confidence", "descriptor_relied_on", "credited_spans", "partial_spans", "uncredited_attempts", "missing_points"],
      "properties": { "ao": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" }, "max": { "type": "integer" }, "level": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "marks": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "confidence": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1 }, "placement_reason": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 120 },
        "descriptor_relied_on": { "type": "object", "required": ["band_id", "paraphrase", "source_ref"], "properties": { "band_id": { "type": "string" }, "paraphrase": { "type": "string" }, "source_ref": { "type": "string" } } },
        "credited_spans": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/span" } }, "partial_spans": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/span" } }, "uncredited_attempts": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/span" } },
        "missing_points": { "type": "array", "maxItems": 3, "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 200 } } } } },
    "per_point": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["marking_point_id", "awarded", "glyph"],
      "properties": { "marking_point_id": { "type": "string" }, "awarded": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "glyph": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/mark_glyph" }, "quote": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "char_start": { "type": ["integer", "null"] }, "char_end": { "type": ["integer", "null"] }, "line_ref": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "failed_atom": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
        "recompute": { "type": ["object", "null"], "properties": { "expected": { "type": "string" }, "seen": { "type": "string" }, "tool": { "const": "sympy" } } }, "ecf_from": { "type": ["string", "null"] } } } },
    "command_word_check": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["command_word", "ceiling_ao", "definition_ref", "met", "coaching_line"], "properties": { "command_word": { "type": "string" }, "ceiling_ao": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" }, "definition_ref": { "type": "string" }, "met": { "type": "boolean" }, "coaching_line": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 200 } } },
    "application_check": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["test", "tested", "passed", "failed"], "properties": { "test": { "const": "cover_the_name" }, "tested": { "type": "integer" }, "passed": { "type": "integer" }, "failed": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "properties": { "line_ref": { "type": "string" }, "quote": { "type": "string" } } } } } },
    "examiner_warnings": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["insight_id", "series", "paraphrase", "matched_line_ref"], "properties": { "insight_id": { "type": "string" }, "series": { "type": "string" }, "paraphrase": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 }, "matched_line_ref": { "type": "string" } } } },
    "next_mark_advice": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["primary_action", "secondary"],
      "properties": { "primary_action": { "type": "object", "required": ["kind", "target_ao", "expected_gain", "text"], "properties": { "kind": { "enum": ["rewrite_paragraph", "add_working", "redo_calculation", "answer_the_command_word", "add_context", "retry_unaided"] }, "target_ao": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "target_line_ref": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "expected_gain": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^\\+[0-9]+( to \\+[0-9]+)?$" }, "text": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 } } },
        "secondary": { "type": "array", "maxItems": 2, "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["kind"], "properties": { "kind": { "enum": ["explain_ao", "another_like_this", "add_working", "retry_unaided"] }, "target_ao": { "type": "string" } } } } } },
    "annotations": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["glyph", "char_start", "char_end"], "properties": { "glyph": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/mark_glyph" }, "char_start": { "type": "integer" }, "char_end": { "type": "integer" } } } },
    "calibration_status": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["state", "badge_text"], "properties": { "state": { "enum": ["gated", "provisional", "uncalibrated"] }, "qwk": { "type": ["number", "null"] }, "human_line": { "type": ["number", "null"] }, "n_scripts": { "type": ["integer", "null"] }, "last_audit": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date" }, "badge_text": { "type": "string" } } },
    "sources": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/source_ref" } },
    "provenance": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["family", "model", "policy_version", "pack_version", "scheme_version", "route_rung", "cache_hit", "marked_at"],
      "properties": { "family": { "type": "string" }, "model": { "type": "string" }, "effort": { "enum": ["quick", "think", "deep"] }, "host": { "type": "string" }, "region": { "type": "string" },
        "policy_version": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}\\.[0-9]{2}\\.[0-9]+(-rc[0-9]+)?$" }, "pack_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/version_tag" },
        "scheme_version": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }, "marker_instructions_version": { "type": "string" },
        "route_rung": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 }, "cache_hit": { "type": "boolean" }, "seed": { "type": ["integer", "null"] },
        "self_consistency": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "properties": { "n": { "type": "integer" }, "totals": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "integer" } }, "level_agreement": { "type": "boolean" } } },
        "second_marker": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": false, "properties": { "family": { "type": "string" }, "model": { "type": "string" }, "total": { "type": "integer" }, "per_ao_levels_match": { "type": "boolean" }, "status": { "enum": ["agree", "disagree", "tie_broken", "human_queue"] } } },
        "seed_script": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "marked_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" } } },
    "challenge_state": { "enum": ["none", "stage1_pending", "upheld", "revised", "split", "stage2_pending", "human_final"] },
    "visibility": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["show_number", "show_predicted_grade", "show_teacher_flag"], "properties": { "show_number": { "type": "boolean" }, "show_predicted_grade": { "type": "boolean" }, "show_teacher_flag": { "type": "boolean" } } },
    "procedure_used": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 80 }
  },
  "allOf": [
    { "if": { "properties": { "calibration_status": { "properties": { "state": { "const": "uncalibrated" } } } } }, "then": { "properties": { "total_band": { "type": "null" }, "visibility": { "properties": { "show_number": { "const": false } } } } } },
    { "if": { "properties": { "header": { "properties": { "level_procedure": { "const": "points" } } } } }, "then": { "required": ["per_point"] }, "else": { "required": ["per_ao"] } }
  ] }

Invariants that JSON Schema cannot express are code checks in 05-PIPE-009: sum(per_ao.marks) == total_band.modal; every marks inside its band's range; every quote a substring of the confirmed transcript at its offsets; credited_spans non-empty whenever marks > 0.

Two notes on provenance, both of which the document previously got wrong in three places:

  • There is no temperature field. 08-ENS-003 records that temperature is not settable on Sonnet 5 / Opus 5, so a {"const": 0} field would be a claim the adapter cannot make. Reproducibility is carried by policy_version + marker_instructions_version + scheme_version + seed, and is measured by 13-MARK-016, not asserted by a constant.
  • policy_version is the one dated manifest label (2026.09.2) and never a per-paper string. Per-paper marker identity is header.scheme_id plus provenance.marker_instructions_version (e.g. mark-9609-p2@7). A Mark whose policy_version fails the pattern is a schema error, not a legacy value.

challenge_state.upheld is a per-Mark outcome (this challenge did not change any AO level) and is not a metric. The aggregate is overturn_rate and only overturn_rate (13-MARK-034, §15.F); upheld_rate does not exist and a grep for it fails the build.

15.C.6 LearnerState@2 (07.1; one document per (user_id, course_id))

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/LearnerState@2",
  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["user_id", "course_id", "pack_version", "policy_version", "mastery", "items", "misconceptions", "calibration", "effort", "prefs", "memories", "rebuilt_at"],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string" }, "course_id": { "type": "string" }, "pack_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/version_tag" }, "policy_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/policy_version" },
    "mastery": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["syllabus_point_id", "M", "state", "state_reason", "retrievability_at_exam", "unaided_correct_days", "timed_correct", "attempts_n", "yield"],
      "properties": { "syllabus_point_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/syllabus_point_id" }, "M": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1 }, "state": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/mastery_state" }, "state_reason": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "retrievability_at_exam": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1 }, "unaided_correct_days": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "format": "date" } }, "timed_correct": { "type": "boolean" }, "brier_topic": { "type": ["number", "null"] },
        "last_attempt_at": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date-time" }, "attempts_n": { "type": "integer" }, "rung_mean_30d": { "type": ["number", "null"] }, "yield": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0 }, "cohort_prior": { "type": "boolean", "default": false } } } },
    "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["item_id", "stability", "difficulty", "due", "reps", "lapses"],
      "properties": { "item_id": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ulid" }, "stability": { "type": "number" }, "difficulty": { "type": "number", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10 }, "due": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }, "reps": { "type": "integer" }, "lapses": { "type": "integer" }, "last_review": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date-time" },
        "seen_solution_until": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date-time" }, "overconfident_flag": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "provenance_mark_id": { "type": ["string", "null"] }, "paper_date_cap": { "type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date" } } } },
    "misconceptions": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["misconception_id", "status", "first_seen", "last_seen", "evidence_attempt_ids"],
      "properties": { "misconception_id": { "type": "string" }, "status": { "enum": ["suspected", "confirmed", "resolved"] }, "first_seen": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }, "last_seen": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }, "evidence_attempt_ids": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "contrast_pass_days": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "format": "date" } } } } },
    "calibration": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["brier_overall_weekly", "predict_postdict"],
      "properties": { "brier_overall_weekly": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["week", "brier", "n", "sure_share"], "properties": { "week": { "type": "string" }, "brier": { "type": "number" }, "n": { "type": "integer" }, "sure_share": { "type": "number" } } } },
        "predict_postdict": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["event_id", "predicted", "postdicted", "actual", "gap"], "properties": { "event_id": { "type": "string" }, "predicted": { "type": "number" }, "postdicted": { "type": "number" }, "actual": { "type": "number" }, "gap": { "type": "number" } } } } } },
    "effort": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["debt_signals_14d", "debt_level", "guard_arm"],
      "properties": { "debt_signals_14d": { "type": "object", "required": ["solution_ratio", "fast_attempt_share", "copy_events", "avoidance_events", "brier_delta", "output_ratio"], "properties": { "solution_ratio": { "type": "number" }, "fast_attempt_share": { "type": "number" }, "copy_events": { "type": "integer" }, "avoidance_events": { "type": "integer" }, "brier_delta": { "type": "number" }, "output_ratio": { "type": "number" } } },
        "debt_level": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 3 }, "guard_arm": { "enum": ["on", "off"] }, "sessions_after_22_exam_week": { "type": "integer" } } },
    "prefs": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": { "intent_by_item_type": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "enum": ["teach_me", "check_steps", "just_answer"] } }, "explain_language": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z]{2}$" }, "decimal_comma": { "type": "boolean" }, "reading_comfort_ref": { "type": "string" }, "extra_time_pct": { "enum": [0, 25, 50] },
        "show_predicted_to_parent": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "memory_paused": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "sensitive_exclusions": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "four_button_grading": { "type": "boolean", "default": false } } },
    "memories": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["id", "text", "source", "created_at", "pinned"], "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" }, "text": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 200 }, "source": { "enum": ["user", "inferred"] }, "why_attempt_ids": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "created_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }, "pinned": { "type": "boolean" } } } },
    "rebuilt_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" }
  } }

15.C.7 Pack@2 (curriculum data for one syllabus version; F§7.1, §06.3)

{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://margin.study/schema/Pack@2",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["pack_version", "board", "syllabus", "papers", "syllabus_nodes", "questions", "mark_scheme_item_ids", "examiner_insights", "thresholds", "option_thresholds", "exemplars", "links", "readiness", "content_hash", "allowed_domains", "compiled_at"],
  "properties": {
    "pack_version": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/version_tag" }, "content_hash": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$" }, "compiled_at": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ts" },
    "board": { "type": "object", "required": ["id", "name", "country", "marking_paradigm", "level_procedure", "annotation_vocab"], "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" }, "name": { "type": "string" }, "country": { "type": "string" }, "marking_paradigm": { "enum": ["expert_marked", "machine_scored", "mixed"] }, "level_procedure": { "enum": ["best_fit", "ladder_up", "top_down", "bullet_evidence"] }, "annotation_vocab": { "type": "array", "items": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/mark_glyph" } } } },
    "syllabus": { "type": "object", "required": ["code", "version_years", "level", "subject", "aos", "command_words", "grade_scale", "source_url", "public"],
      "properties": { "code": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}$" }, "version_years": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "integer" }, "minItems": 2, "maxItems": 2 }, "level": { "enum": ["IGCSE", "O Level", "AS", "A Level", "IB DP", "AP", "GCSE", "IAL", "national"] }, "subject": { "type": "string" },
        "aos": { "type": "array", "minItems": 2, "items": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["ao", "name", "definition", "wording_status", "source_ref", "weight_overall"],
          "properties": { "ao": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/ao" }, "name": { "type": "string" }, "definition": { "type": "string", "minLength": 8 },
            "wording_status": { "enum": ["own_paraphrase", "licensed_verbatim"], "default": "own_paraphrase" }, "source_ref": { "$ref": "common@1#/$defs/source_ref" }, "weight_overall": { "type": "number" } },
          "allOf": [ { "if": { "properties": { "wording_status": { "const": "licensed_verbatim" } } }, "then": { "properties": { "source_ref": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "syllabus" } } } } } } ] } },
        "command_words": { "type": "array", "minItems": 8, "items": { "$ref": "CommandWord@1" } },
        "grade_scale": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "pum_map": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": { "type": "integer" } }, "pum_verified": { "type": "boolean", "default": false }, "source_url": { "type": "string", "format": "uri" }, "public": { "type": "boolean" } } },
    "papers": { "type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["number", "duration_min", "marks", "ao_weights", "question_types", "allowed_materials", "minutes_per_mark", "markable", "twin_state"],

CommandWord@1 and ItemTags@1 are defined in 15.D. Readiness is computed from readiness_evidence by the compiler (§06.4), never set by hand; a Pack whose readiness claims a state its evidence does not support fails validation.

IDRequirementAcceptance
15-SCHM-006Enum literals are snake_case, everywhere, with no hyphens. gold_seeded (not gold-seeded), expert_marked, machine_scored. Snake_case is what the DDL in §11.2, the compiler and 06-PACK-007 already emit; the hyphen forms were a display spelling that leaked into a wire format. Display strings render from the §15.E catalogue, never from the enum value.Repo lint rejects a hyphen inside any enum literal in schemas/** and any ∈ {…} list in this document; a Pack persisted with gold-seeded fails validation on read.
15-SCHM-007papers[].twin_state carries provisional as a first-class value. §06.3 writes it, 05-MARK-010 renders it and the whole product surfaces it; a paper at floor A without a measured human line is provisional, which is neither gold_seeded nor gated.State-machine test covering all six values; a calibration_status.state = provisional Mark whose paper's twin_state is not provisional fails the consistency check.
15-SCHM-008licence_basis is an object, not a bare string, and quotation is one of its bases. Short attributed extracts — the 18 command-word definitions per Pack and every ≤40-word extract under 06.2's extract rule — record {basis: "quotation", quotation: {exception, jurisdiction, reviewed_by, reviewed_at}}. Recording them as own was false, and it made 06-TAKE-021's per-document report unanswerable for exactly the content most likely to be complained about. own now means only text we wrote or facts we hold.Every row in extract_log joins to a document whose licence_basis.basis ∈ {licensed, quotation, public_with_permission}; a quotation row with no reviewed_by fails the compile.
15-SCHM-009links[].derivation replaces the former links[].provenance, whose four values (compiler/human/OWN/LICENSED) mixed a build method with a rights class and gave the three-member provenance enum a fourth vocabulary (06-PROV-001). Rights stay on documents[].provenance; how a link was made is derivation.Schema diff job flags any surviving links[].provenance; 06-PACK-006's compiler test asserts a compiler_v<n> or compiler_v<n>+human value on every generated link.
15-SCHM-010syllabus.aos[].definition defaults to own_paraphrase. 06-PACK-004 says command words are the only verbatim board text in a Pack; requiring a verbatim AO definition would have forced a second verbatim site the extract log does not cover. Under a licence the same field may hold board wording with wording_status: licensed_verbatim, and the 8-gram overlap check that guards credit_text applies to it unchanged.A Pack with wording_status: own_paraphrase and an 8-gram overlap against the syllabus PDF above threshold fails mapped.
15-SCHM-011A syllabus revision is a mapping, not a silent renumber. Pack@2.node_aliases[] records every renumbered / split / merged / withdrawn node from the previous pack_version. A Course pins its pack_version at creation (14-PACK-012) and is never migrated in place; historical Attempts and Marks join through the aliases, so Progress and the Learner Graph read across a version boundary without re-marking anything. Re-marking an old Attempt under a new Pack is prohibited — the Mark records the version it was made under, and a mark that changes because the syllabus was renumbered is not a mark.Replay test: an Attempt from 9609:2023-2025 renders its original Mark byte-identically after 9609:2026-2028 goes live, and its syllabus point resolves through node_aliases on Progress; a split alias with no share fails the compile.
15-SCHM-012papers[].markable is required, so "what we don't mark" is a stored fact rather than a support answer. full (the marker produces a number when the paper is gated) · feedback_only (spans and feedback, never a number — practical schemes until their family gold set passes, 05-SCHM-010) · not_marked with a not_marked_reason rendered verbatim to the student and the teacher. 9702 P3, 9701 P3 and every practical-performance component are not_marked: "This paper is assessed at the bench; we can rehearse the planning and analysis paper (P5) instead."Course setup and the calibration page both render the not_marked and feedback_only papers with their reasons; a paper with markable: not_marked and no reason fails the compile; a Mark emitted for a not_marked paper is a P1 incident.

15.DQuestion-tagging schema and the Cambridge command-word → AO table

Two schemas complete the set in 15.C: ItemTags@1 (referenced from Item@2.tags) and CommandWord@1 (referenced from Pack@2.syllabus.command_words). Every Item — imported past-paper part, generated Item, Card, diagnostic distractor — validates against ItemTags@1 before persist (00-APP-003); validation failure is a rejection, never a coercion.

IDRequirementAcceptance
15-TAG-001tags.syllabus_points[] uses the common@1 form {code}/{dotted path} (9609/5.3). The Pack's internal node id (syl_9609_2026#5.3, §06.3) maps to it 1:1 by construction; the compiler emits both and CI asserts the bijection. Numbering mirrors the syllabus exactly so a syllabus revision is a mapping table, not a retag.Compiler test: every syllabus_nodes[].id round-trips through the mapper; 0 orphan tags.
15-TAG-002tags.question_family is derived, never typed: {syllabus_code}:P{paper}:{scheme_type}:{marks_total}:{command_word_lower} — e.g. 9609:P2:levels:20:evaluate, 0580:P2:points:3:calculate. It is the unit of every marking gate (13.3), of seeded-QA auto-pause (13-MARK-030) and of gold-set stratification (05-GATE-001).Derivation is a pure function with a fixture table; a hand-set question_family fails schema validation.
15-TAG-003tags.ao_split sums to marks_total, and each AO present is ≤ the ao_ceiling implied by the command word (15-CMD-002). A levels Item stores the per-AO max from the grid, not an invented split.05-SCHM/compiler validation error naming the offending sum (15-RUBR-004).
15-TAG-004tags.difficulty_prior ∈ [0,1] is a facility proxy (expected proportion of marks earned), seeded from threshold history, replaced by Item.stats.p_correct at stats.n ≥ 30. It drives sequencing (§04) and mark-yield (§07), never the marker.difficulty_prior appears in no marking prompt (prompt-diff check).
15-TAG-005tags.misconception_targets[] cite ids from the Pack's syllabus_nodes[].misconceptions[]; an id absent from the Pack version pinned on the Item is a build error. A generated Item with a distractor and no misconception target fails the generator gate.Referential check at Pack compile; generator eval asserts ≥1 target per distractor.
15-TAG-006tags.source records provenance of the question, distinct from Item.provenance: past-paper refs, generator refs, or {upload_id, transient: true} for bring-your-own-paper. A user-upload source is never written to the global retrieval index (§06).Ledger test: 0 upload-sourced tags in the shared index.
15-TAG-007tags.diagram_required = true forces Item.diagram_required and the scheme's vision_status; while vision_status = provisional_teacher_confirm the Mark shows a band and the provisional banner and never a number (§05; the banner string is §15.E · mark.header.diagram).Fixture: a diagram Item below the 300-item diagram gold set returns visibility.show_number = false.
15-TAG-008Tagging is model-assisted then human-verified: the compiler proposes, a content editor accepts, verified_by records the human. A Pack reaches mapped only at ≥95% verified across 3 series (§14.3).Mapping-review dashboard count.
15-TAG-009Tags are versioned with the Pack, never edited in place; a retag increments tags_version and leaves prior Attempts joined to the tags they were marked under.Attempt replay reproduces the historical Mark.

15-CMD-001 The table below is a build seed, not the contract. definition_verbatim for a live Pack is extracted from that syllabus PDF and stored with source_ref (§06.2 extract rule); the subset of words differs per syllabus. Why: only analyse, evaluate and justify were read from primary sources; the rest are prior knowledge (INDEX §D) and a Pack that ships them as canon is a factual-accuracy defect, not a wording preference.

15-CMD-002 AO ceiling is enforced before marking (05-PROC-012): a response whose command word is not met is capped at the stated ceiling and the coaching line is emitted verbatim. 15-CMD-003 Tariff column drives generator legality (05-GEN-001) and pacing pills (05-TIME-002), never marking.

Command wordCambridge definition senseAO ceiling (typical AOs)Typical tariffWhat earns the top level / final markReason code most often fired
DefineGive the precise meaningAO12Meaning that does not reuse the term; the discriminating feature presentTERM_REPEATED_IN_DEFINITION
StateExpress in clear termsAO11–2One correct, unhedged statement; no explanation needed or creditedASSERTION_NO_LINK
GiveProduce an answer from a source or recallAO11–2Answer taken from the named source, not inventedOUT_OF_SCOPE
IdentifyName, select or recogniseAO11–3The named thing, correctly spelled/attributed; lists beyond the tariff are not readWRONG_STAKEHOLDER
OutlineSet out the main pointsAO1 (AO2)2–4Points, not prose; each point distinctDUPLICATE_POINT
DescribeState the points of a topic; give characteristics and main featuresAO1 (AO2)3–5The number of distinct features the tariff implies; no causal chain requiredDUPLICATE_POINT
CalculateWork out from given facts, figures or informationAO22–4Formula, substitution, working, correct units; ECF applies to a wrong carried valueNO_WORKING, UNITS_MISSING, SIG_FIG
DemonstrateShow how, or give an exampleAO22–4A worked instance tied to the given context, not a restated ruleGENERIC_NOT_CONTEXT
ExplainSet out purposes or reasons; make relationships clear; say why and/or how, supported by evidenceAO2 (AO1–AO3)3–6One "because" chain per mark, applied to the case where the paper is case-basedSINGLE_LINK, ASSERTION_NO_LINK
CommentGive an informed opinionAO2–AO33–6Opinion grounded in the data given, not a preferenceGENERIC_NOT_CONTEXT
CompareIdentify and comment on similarities and/or differencesAO2–AO34–8Explicit comparative links ("whereas", "by contrast"); two parallel descriptions score halfSINGLE_LINK
ContrastIdentify and comment on differencesAO2–AO34–8Differences stated as differences, both sides named in each pointSINGLE_LINK
PredictSuggest what may happen from the available informationAO2–AO32–4A stated outcome plus the mechanism that produces itASSERTION_NO_LINK
SuggestApply knowledge to a new situation; propose reasons or considerationsAO2–AO33–6A proposal that fits the constraints stated in the stimulusGENERIC_NOT_CONTEXT
AnalyseIdentify components and the relationships between them; draw out and relate implicationsAO3 (AO1–AO3)8–12Two or more links in the chain per developed point, in context; evaluation here earns nothingSINGLE_LINK, EVAL_IN_ANALYSE
ExamineInvestigate closely, in detailAO38–12Structured interrogation of the mechanism, with the limits of the evidence notedSINGLE_LINK
DevelopTake forward to a more advanced stageAO32–4Extends a point already made; a new unrelated point is not developmentDUPLICATE_POINT
SketchMake a simple freehand drawing showing key featuresAO2–AO32–4Axes labelled, shape and intercepts correct; accuracy of scale not requiredILLEGIBLE (diagram Items are provisional, 15-TAG-007)
DiscussWrite about issues or topics in depth in a structured wayAO4 (AO1–AO4)12–20Both sides developed and a judgement that follows from the argumentASSERTION_NO_LINK
EvaluateMake an informed judgement about the importance or value of something, supported by evidenceAO4 (AO1–AO4)12–30Two sides weighed and a justified, contextual judgement with an "it depends on…" conditionEVAL_IN_ANALYSE (inverted: analysis only)
AssessMake an informed judgementAO412–20A judgement with criteria stated; a conclusion that restates the points is L1ASSERTION_NO_LINK

RecommendAdvise a course of action with reasonsAO412–20One recommendation, conditions for success, and why the alternative was rejectedASSERTION_NO_LINK
AdviseGive a reasoned course of action to a named partyAO412–20Advice addressed to the named stakeholder; advice to the wrong party caps AO2WRONG_STAKEHOLDER

15-CMD-004 The coaching line is a template with slots, never a literal. For every word above the Pack stores coaching_line in the voice of §01.6, as an interpolation:

"{Command} — {requirement}. None found, so {ceiling_ao} cannot reach Level {n}."

{ceiling_ao} comes from that Pack's CommandWord@1.ao_ceiling and {n} from the grid's top band index; Evaluate on 9609 renders "Evaluate — a judgement is required. None found, so AO4 cannot reach Level 3." Two things this fixes: 9708 and 0455 Economics have three AOs and 9702 Physics has AO1–AO3, so a literal "AO4" names an AO that does not exist on those Packs; and the ceiling is a ceiling — the command word says which AOs are on offer, it never sets a level inside an AO that is on offer (05-MARK-005, 15.A.3). Acceptance: no command word in a mapped Pack has a null coaching_line; the Mark view renders it from the Pack, never from the model.

15-CMD-005 No string in the catalogue contains a literal AO number. Every AO reference in a rendered string is a slot filled from the Pack. Acceptance: the Pack build fails on a coaching_line matching /AO[1-6]/ outside a {…} slot; the §15.E lint applies the same rule to catalogue/en.json.

15.EMicrocopy: 40 strings by context

§15.E is the string catalogue. There is exactly one. The forty numbered rows below are the strings the earlier sections named individually; the three keyed tables after them close the sets that 09-QA-037, 10-CONV-006 and 10-SETT-002 assert but that nobody wrote out — session and stream states, an empty state per §10 screen, and a consequence line per Settings control. §01.6 owns the voice rules and points here for the strings; 09.11's numbered pairs and §10.24's repeats are the same strings under these keys and hold no independent wording. Where an earlier section printed a string that differs from the row here, the row here is the product string and the earlier print is corrected.

IDRequirementAcceptance
15-STR-001Every string below exists in the catalogue under its exact key; no component contains a user-facing literal.i18n lint: 0 literals outside the catalogue; 0 missing keys at build.
15-STR-002Every "Don't" cell is a regression fixture in the lint corpus and must fail at least one rule of 09-COPY-003. A "Don't" that passes the lint is a lint bug, not an acceptable string.pnpm lint:copy --corpus reports one failing rule per Don't row.
15-STR-003{…} slots are typed and filled by the caller; a rendered string with an unfilled slot, or a number without its basis (series, n, or "practice estimate"), fails the render test.Snapshot test per key with a fixture payload.
15-STR-004RU/KZ catalogues are translations of these keys reviewed by a native examiner-teacher (09-COPY-006); a locale missing a key falls back to English and logs, never renders the key.Locale-coverage report; 0 raw keys in a screenshot diff.
15-STR-005Strings are cited by key, never by row number. The citation form anywhere in this document, in code comments and in PR bodies is §15.E · <key> — for example §15.E · retest.scheduled. 15-STR-NNN is a requirement ID and nothing else; a citation of the form 15-STR-0NN meaning "row NN of the table" is a defect and resolves to nothing.Docs lint: every 15-STR-NNN citation resolves to a requirement defined in this subsection; every §15.E · key citation resolves to a catalogue key.
15-STR-006No price literal in any in-product string. Prices render only in Settings › Usage › Plan and on the pricing page, both from config/pricing.yaml. A limit notice names the limit and the plan, never the amount — the regional tiers make any single figure wrong in six markets (14-GTM-001).09-COPY-003 rule (k); a currency symbol or a bare numeral followed by /mo in catalogue/*.json fails the lint.
15-STR-007Every number in a string is a slot filled from its owning config, never typed into the string: quota numbers from limits.yaml (§03.3, 11-COST-001), upload ceilings from limits.yaml, retention days from config/retention.yaml (§11.13), dates from series_calendar. A hard-coded number in a catalogue value fails the lint even when it is currently correct.Lint over catalogue/*.json: any integer outside a {…} slot, other than in a fixed idiom, is reported with its key.
15-STR-008Coverage is a report, not a claim. The build emits catalogue/coverage.json listing, per §10 screen, whether empty.<screen> exists; per control in 10.19, whether its settings.<control>.consequence exists; and per key cited anywhere in §00–§15, whether it resolves. A missing key is a build failure with the citing site named.pnpm i18n:coverage exits non-zero on any gap; the report is attached to the release artefact.

15.FGlossary of canonical terms

15-GLOS-001 This is the canonical vocabulary (00-USE-003). Use these nouns in code identifiers, table names, UI strings, telemetry fields and docs; this is the only place a synonym may appear, and only to map it to canon. A term introduced by a PR is added here in the same PR (00-APP-005). Acceptance: a repository grep for the banned synonyms in the last column returns zero user-facing hits.

Core objects (SYNTHESIS §3.1; schemas in 15.C).

TermMeaningOwner
CourseThe home object: board + syllabus code + version + level + exam session + target grade + papers. Owns the Pack version, syllabus tree, Attempts, Cards, Plan, memory, files and Sessions. Not "subject", not "class".§02, §07
AskA conversation with no Course attached. Never counts as study; writes no Attempt, no memory, no Card and no Plan change. The screen is §10.26.§03, §10
PackCurriculum data for one syllabus version (papers, AO weights, verbatim command words, content tree, questions, schemes, examiner insights, thresholds, exemplars, links). A new board is a new Pack, never new code.§06
Pack readinessdraft → ingested → mapped → gold_seeded → gated → live, computed from readiness_evidence, never set by hand (§14.3). Snake_case is the wire form everywhere (15-SCHM-006); the display strings render from §15.E.§06, §14
ItemAny atomic retrievable or gradable unit: definition, formula, skill, evaluation point, diagram rule, or exam-style question part with tariff, command word, AO split and scheme.§05, §06
Question family{code}:P{paper}:{scheme_type}:{marks}:{command_word} — the unit of marking gates, seeded-QA auto-pause and gold-set stratification (15-TAG-002).§05, §13
AttemptThe atomic record of learning; every metric, mastery update, teacher view and Receipt is a projection of Attempts. A feature that does not create or improve Attempts is not in the MVP.§04, §07
TurnOne Learn-mode assistant message: ≤120 words, one move, one question, explicit hand-back. Carries rung, lint_result, model, cache hit.§04
MarkThe per-AO marking record for an Attempt: band, spans, reason codes, command-word check, calibration status.§05
CardAn FSRS-6 retrieval item with provenance ("From your Mark · 9609 P2 Q3(b)").§04, §10
SessionA conversation scoped to one Course and one topic by default; drift prompts a new Session.§03
PlanWeekly blocks on the exam spine from the phase mix and mark-yield priorities. Proposed, never silently applied.§04, §10
SourceA page-addressable document with a trust rank (1 syllabus > 2 endorsed textbook > 3 mark scheme > 4 examiner report > 5 revision notes > 6 user upload) and a provenance class.§06
ClassA teacher's group bound to one Course.§10, §12
Learner GraphThe projection of Attempts into mastery per syllabus point, misconceptions, seen-solution Items and calibration. Lives outside the chat and is re-injected.§07

Engine terms.

TermMeaningOwner
Examiner TwinThe calibrated marker for one paper — prompt + scheme + anchors + negative exemplars + gate state (not_yet_calibrated / gold_seeded / provisional / gated / live / paused). One per paper, never one per product.§05
Effort GateNo solution content on a gradable Item before an attempt, a plan, or "don't know where to start" + one sentence. State lives on the Attempt, enforced by the Orchestrator, never by a refusal.§04
Help LadderFive rungs, one rung per Turn: 1 orienting question · 2 hint at the next step · 3 partial scaffold (structure or first link) · 4 worked micro-example on a parallel Item (a paragraph, never a model essay) · 5 the solution, labelled. Entry rung by mastery × item type.§04
Intent chipsTeach me · Check my steps · Just the answer. The third is honoured after one attempt, labelled, and followed by a near-transfer Item and a 24–72 h retest.§04, §10
Seen solutionThe flag written when rung-5 content is delivered. Without it plus a scheduled retest, the Turn is a label failure (13-PED-011).§04
LeakSolution content emitted before the gate is satisfied and outside the "Just the answer" path (definition in 13.2). CI gate: <5%.§04, §13
Effort dialQuick · Think · Deep, with auto-escalation for maths. Not a model picker; vendor names appear as chips on marking cards only.§08
Mark-YieldExpected marks gained per hour on a syllabus point = tariff exposure × gap to mastery × learnability ÷ estimated hours. Orders the Plan and the Easter blitz.§07
Cognitive-Debt GuardSix signals (solution-request ratio, attempt latency <8 s, paste ratio, retrieval avoidance, confidence gap, rung-5 share) with graduated non-punitive responses; L1 at MVP, user-level randomised.§04
Learning ReceiptThe signed, exportable process log for a coursework draft: attempts, hints used, drafts, marks, timestamps. What makes draft-feedback mode defensible.§12
Provenance classesOWN (ours or facts), LICENSED (under a signed licence, extract-capped), USER (a student's upload — transient, tenant-scoped, never in global retrieval). There is no scraped class in the codebase.§06
Calibration badgeThe per-paper trust line: "Calibrated on 9609 P2 · agreement 0.82 · 312 scripts". The marketing number equals the product number.§05, §13
Provisional MarkA Mark shown with feedback and spans but no number — either the paper is below gate, or the Item is diagram-dependent and awaiting teacher confirmation.§05
Challenge-a-markThe student's one-tap dispute route; re-marks with a second family and routes >1-level disagreement to a human. Targets: challenge_rate < 3%, overturn_rate < 30%.§05, §10
Overturn rateoverturn_rate = challenges in which any AO level changed ÷ challenges. The only challenge-outcome metric. "Upheld" is retired: §05 used it to mean the mark stood (target ≥70%) and §08 and §13 used it to mean the student won (target <30%), so an alarm built from either reading fired backwards against the other. challenge_state.upheld survives as the state of one Mark and is never aggregated; upheld_rate does not exist and a grep for it fails the build (13-MARK-034).§05, §13
Seeded QAPre-marked scripts injected into production traffic at 2–5% per question family with board-style tolerances; a breaching family pauses within one batch.§13
Generosity correctionThe signed-error adjustment applied because LLMs mark more leniently than trained examiners; audited monthly per model, must stay within ±0.3/10.§05, §13
UMG/hUnaided Mark Gain per study hour — the north star: marks gained on unaided, calibrated, exam-format work divided by hours studied. DAU, minutes and message counts are guard-rails, never targets.§14
Policy objectPer-tenant {residency, allowed_providers, retention_days, age_band, consent_mode} that drives routing; EU/UK school tenants route to Vertex regional models.§08, §11
Between-papers modeFrom T−7 per component: next paper only, no new material, no blocks past 90 minutes after 22:00, grace limits, distress script live.§04, §10

Exam vocabulary (board terms; definitions per Pack are verbatim from the syllabus).

TermMeaning
AOAssessment Objective. Cambridge 9609: AO1 Knowledge · AO2 Application · AO3 Analysis · AO4 Evaluation, weighted per paper, not just overall.
Command wordThe verb that fixes the response shape and the AO ceiling (15.D).
Best-fit / ladder-up / top-downThe three level-award procedures; Cambridge uses best fit per AO grid, AQA ladder-up, OCR top-down. Stored per board as level_procedure.
Marking pointA structured scheme row (M/A/B/DM/DB/FT) with conjunctive conditions, accept/reject/ignore lists and ECF flags.
Level descriptor / evidence ruleThe band text, plus the machine-checkable rule that decides whether a response evidences it (e.g. "≥2 links in the chain, in context").
Indicative contentExamples the board expects but does not require; a valid alternative is credited (NOT_IN_INDICATIVE_VALID_ALT).
ECF / OFRError carried forward / own figure rule — credit for correct method on a wrong earlier value. ISW ignore subsequent working · CAO correct answer only · ORA or reverse argument · BOD benefit of the doubt.
ECRExample Candidate Response — Cambridge's published marked scripts; Tier 0 of the gold set (seed, never sole truth).
ToleranceThe mark difference a seeded script may show before the family pauses (board practice; per scheme record).
QWKQuadratic weighted kappa — the agreement statistic published per paper. Brier score: calibration of the student's own confidence.
Threshold / PUM / option gradeRaw component threshold → percentage uniform mark → option-level grade. A* exists only at option level; predicted grades are ranges across ≥3 series.
FSRS-6 / retrievabilityThe scheduler and its probability of recall now; desired retention ramps 0.85 → 0.90 → 0.95 toward the exam and intervals are capped at the exam date.
Mastery statesUnseen · Shaky · Secure · Exam-ready (4-state pip with decay and a "why"). Never a bare percentage.

Banned synonyms (lint, 00-USE-003): "study mode", "tutor mode", "exam mode", "quiz mode" → the modes are Learn · Practise · Mark; "streak", "XP", "level up" → absent entirely; "grade my essay" → Mark; "project" → Course; "deck" → Cards; "AI grader" → Examiner Twin; "confidence score" for a Mark → band.

15.GFounder decisions E1–E17: defaults and what changes

15-FDR-001 Numbering is canonical here. E1–E17 are the founder questions of research/INDEX.md §E. SYNTHESIS §15 collapses them into twelve rows (its row 11 = [E13][E15], its row 12 = [E14][E17]); the table in §00.3 numbers those two rows E11 and E12 for brevity. Tag dependent code with the INDEX number — founder-default:E13 — and treat §00.3's E11/E12 as aliases for E13/E15 and E14/E17. Acceptance: grep -r "founder-default:E" src/ returns hits for E1–E10 and E13–E15, E17 and none for E11/E12 (settled FINAL, below).

15-FDR-002 Build the default, tag the dependants, do not fork. Each row's "If reversed" column is the migration, not a flag. You may not build both branches (00-AMB-002). Every dependent string, config key and migration carries the tag so a reversal is a search-and-replace.

15-FDR-003 Reversal cost is stated in days. The estimate is the working days of one engineer plus named non-engineering work; a decision whose cost rises above 15 days if taken late is marked decide-before, with the date it must be answered.

EDecisionDefault adopted (SYNTHESIS §15)Sections touchedIf the founder decides otherwise
E1Content library and rightsLibrary treated as USER/OWN: notes-class material plus hand-made scheme extracts; no licensed textbooks assumed§05, §06With licensed textbooks: add LICENSED documents to the ledger with licence_id and extract caps, turn on "show me in the book" deep links to textbook pages, raise trust rank 2 above notes, and re-run retrieval evals with the new corpus (≈8 days + counsel review). With official papers/schemes/ERs licensed: text_status moves from ref_only to licensed, the Mark can quote grid lines verbatim, and 12 UI strings drop the "attributed extract" hedge (≈12 days). Nothing in the marker changes — the scheme is already structured data.
E2Cambridge licensing postureShip on OWN + USER + deep links; open Cambridge/CLA talks in month 1; do not delay launch§06, §14Licence first: launch slips to the licence date (unbounded); build unchanged, gates unchanged, but the roadmap's March 2027 MVP date (§14.1) and the June-2027 series bet are void. Refused / takedown: the kill switch and 24 h takedown SLA already exist; the effect is on GTM copy and school outreach, not code. Decide-before: 1 Nov 2026 (month-1 outreach).
E3Second curriculum after CAIEEdexcel IAL (sibling Pack, >60% reuse), then UK boards, then UNT before ЕГЭ§02, §14UK boards first: the compiler needs level_procedure ladder_up (AQA) and top_down (OCR) plus their annotation vocabularies — already in Pack@2, so ≈6 days of Pack work, but GTM shifts head-on into Save My Exams and Medly (§01.4). ЕГЭ first: adds RU UI to the MVP (E13), a payments and sanctions review, and a machine_scored/expert_marked hybrid engine — ≈40 days and a new legal posture.

Decide-before: 1 Dec 2026.

Ban entirely: delete two routes; cost rises ≈4% on second-solve; no product change.
E6Calibration budget≈300 double-marked scripts × 6 papers plus 2–3 contracted examiners for Year 1§05, §13Not funded: no paper reaches gated; every Mark is a Provisional Mark; predicted grades are absent; differentiators 1 and 8 (§01.3) are withdrawn from all copy; the calibration page lists every paper as "not yet calibrated". The product still ships and still teaches — it is no longer an Examiner Twin. Funded larger: more papers gate sooner; no code change. Decide-before: 1 Oct 2026 (examiner recruitment lead time).
E7Publish calibration numbers externallyYes, per paper, monthly, once gated; below-gate papers listed "not yet calibrated"§01, §13No: the monthly report becomes internal-only; the in-product badge stays (it is a non-negotiable, 00-NON); differentiator 1 loses its proof and the tagline's second half is unsupported in marketing. Change is a route flag on one page plus a marketing rewrite (≈2 days, high strategic cost).
E8Free-tier costAccept $0.5–1/MAU in season with the §14 quotas§03, §14Tighter: lower the levels-Mark allowance in limits.yaml; the pricing page and in-app meter regenerate from the same file, so the change is config plus a 14-day in-app changelog notice (≈1 day) — but the free tier must stay genuinely useful and never cut silently (non-negotiable). More generous: same mechanism, higher burn.
E9Price list and guarantee appetite$8 monthly / $59 until-exams / $19 family / $10 school seat / −40% regional; no guarantee SKU before Year 2§14Different prices: config plus store products (≈2 days). Guarantee SKU in Year 1: requires two series of calibration data we will not have, a refund-reserve model, and a claims process; blocked by E6, not by engineering.
E10NameMargin; fallback Nib; clearance searches in month 1§01Clearance fails: flip brand.name and the logotype asset; the build must produce zero residual strings (01-NAME-002). Cost ≈1 day if 01-NAME-002 is honoured, ≈10 days if it is not. Decide-before: 1 Dec 2026 (before store listings).

E12RL-tuned tutoring layerSettled FINAL: prompts + Orchestrator vetting for Year 1; RL only if production leak >5% at scale§04, §08Not founder-owned. The trigger is a measured leak rate, not a preference.

Exam terminology stays in the exam language either way.

Native mobile: a second client; the §10 screen spec survives, the §09 tokens must be re-expressed (≈60 days).
E16Teacher/parent surfaces at MVPSettled FINAL: calibrator scope (class code, locked assignments, attempts/hints view, audit-and-override, mock import, calibration queue), free forever; parent digest v0§10, §12Not founder-owned. The full console is a v1 SHOULD.

No engineering change; a permanent positioning cost.

E. Unknowns only our own data can close. No external source exists for any of these; each is a measurement, not a search: our marker's QWK per paper against a measured human line (15-OPEN-020); production leak rate at scale (§13 guard-rail; the trigger for E12); whether the Cognitive-Debt Guard costs ≤2 pp of 30-day retention (13.8 Layer 1); the true distribution of predicted-vs-actual grade error after the June 2027 series (13.8 Layer 2); UMG/h itself, which has no prior art and whose first honest value arrives with the first cohort. There is also no survey of Cambridge International students' AI use and no RU/KZ student voice in the research — the persona sheets (§02.1) are built on adjacent evidence and must be re-validated with 20 interviews in the first partner-school cohort (Research lead, M5).

15.IReading map to the research appendices

15-READ-001 Research is evidence, never authority. Precedence is fixed by 00-AMB-001: SYNTHESIS → this document → JUDGING → research/* → designs/vision-*. No pull request may cite a research file as the reason for a product behaviour; cite the requirement ID, and cite the research only inside a "Why:" line. Acceptance: a PR body containing research/ without a requirement ID is rejected in review.

15-READ-002 Read the index, not the briefs. research/INDEX.md compresses ~73k words into decisions A1–A61, numbers §B, contradictions §C, care-list §D, founder questions §E and a per-section reading guide §G. Open a brief only when §G or the table below sends you to a named section. Budget: §G's per-section list is the whole reading requirement for a section owner.

15-READ-003 Confidence labels travel with the number. INDEX §B marks each number H (primary page fetched), M (snippet or secondary summary) or L (prior knowledge or our own decision). An L number is our target, phrased as one; an M number never appears in student-facing or marketing copy (15-OPEN-002).

SYNTHESIS §0 and §3 → §00 of this document → the §NN you own → INDEX §G's line for that section → the two or three brief sections it names → 15.F (vocabulary) → 15.H (what is not yet known in your area).
